استعمرن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْمَرْنَ (istaʕmarna) /is.taʕ.mar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
# اُسْتُعْمِرْنَ (ustuʕmirna) /us.tuʕ.mir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
# اِسْتَعْمِرْنَ (istaʕmirna) /is.taʕ.mir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
